caseNameFull: P. H. Harris v. United States
summary: Appeal from the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Charles B. Stuart, Mr. John F. Sharp and Mr. Marion K. Cruce, for appellant, submitted., Mr. Assistant Attorney General Riter, with whom Mr. Solicitor General Beck and Mr. Hi L. Underwood were on the brief, for the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of United States v. Krall, 174 U. S. 385, 389-391; German National Bank v. Speckert, 181 U. S. 405, 409; United States v. Beatty, 232 U. S. 463, 466.
